title: Relative glueing over the affine opens of a scheme
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose given, for every affine open $U\subseteq S$, a scheme $X_U$ with a morphism $f_U:X_U\to U$, and for all affine opens $V\subseteq U\subseteq S$ a morphism $\rho^U_V:X_V\to X_U$ over $U$ (i.e. $f_U\circ\rho^U_V=f_V$ followed by $V\subseteq U$), such that (a) $\rho^U_V$ induces an isomorphism of $X_V$ onto the open subscheme $f_U^{-1}(V)$ of $X_U$, over $V$, and (b) $\rho^U_U=\mathrm{id}$ and $\rho^U_W=\rho^U_V\circ\rho^V_W$ for affine opens $W\subseteq V\subseteq U$. Then there are a scheme $X$, a morphism $f:X\to S$ and, for every affine open $U\subseteq S$, an isomorphism $i_U:f^{-1}(U)\to X_U$ of schemes over $U$, such that for affine opens $V\subseteq U$ the composition $X_V\xrightarrow{i_V^{-1}}f^{-1}(V)\hookrightarrow f^{-1}(U)\xrightarrow{i_U}X_U$ is $\rho^U_V$.
